products.label: SMACS 0723 flagged cluster members, CDS J/A+A/699/A105
products.process: Keep the catalogue's flagged members; place each at the cluster's Planck 2018 comoving distance, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky; tone by magnitude.
limitations: A member's depth within the cluster is assumed (as deep as wide), not measured.
The survey is wide: its members span about 1.6° by 0.34°, far beyond the 2.3 arcmin picture, so most dots lie outside it.
